observations: Intermediate Bulk Container (IBC) in a galvanized steel cage.
Volume markings for 1000 Liters and 250 Gallons embossed on the plastic in photo 2.
Bottom discharge valve with a blue handle visible in photos 0 and 1.
Red safety or instruction label on the front of the tank.
Multiple similar units visible in the background, suggesting a storage yard.
Watermark 'BONIFACE OVIENK' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' on all photos.

claims.claim: To store industrial liquids or hazardous chemicals
claims.evidence: This is the standard design purpose for IBC tanks of this type.
No food-grade certification symbols (e.g., wine glass and fork) are visible in the photos.

claims.claim: used only once for clean water

claims.evidence: Requires a liquid fill test to confirm integrity of the tank and valve.
The top of the tank where the main fill lid is located is not shown.

risks.proof: Photo of the manufacturer's stamp showing the food-grade symbol.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-food grade industrial tank

risks.proof: Video of the tank filled with water showing the valve and base are dry.
Photo of the top of the tank showing the lid in place.

proof_requests: Photo of the top of the tank showing the fill lid.
Close-up photo of any manufacturer stamps or food-grade symbols on the plastic.
Video of the bottom valve being opened and closed while the tank contains liquid.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a 1000L IBC tank. While the 'food grade' and 'no leak' claims are unproven, the item can be priced at its worst-case value as a used, non-food grade industrial container.
